topics.topic: Authority required to resend a draft-write effect after a not_applied result
questions: If a draft-write attempt is resolved `not_applied`, must the resend require a per-effect owner approval (despite draft-write normally using flow activation), or can it resend under activation/grant rules without an approval object?
If a `draft-write` attempt is concluded `not_applied`, must resend obtain a fresh per-effect owner approval, or continue to use flow activation authority?

quotes: An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh approval, even where a standing approval exists.

- `authority`: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send
  the flow activation under which the run started (State 2, A10 rule 6; State
  5) — except a resend after `not_applied`, which, whatever its class, records
  the fresh approval it needed;
judgement.why: The texts explicitly state that resend after `not_applied` needs a fresh per-effect approval even for `draft-write`.

topics.topic: Whether a slot can exist before any admitted activation and what current implementation returns then
questions: Can a slot exist with no current implementation yet, and if so what do inspect/repair actions return for "current implementation"?

topics.topic: Whether credential-backed header value changes are included in EffectApproval request_digest matching
questions: When a credential-backed header value changes, is that header value part of the approval match (`request_digest`) or explicitly excluded/normalized?

topics.topic: Whether multiple pending EffectApprovals can exist for one waiting node and how approve/refuse targets one
questions: Can multiple `requested`/unused approvals coexist for the same run-node-map position, and which one does the owner's approve/refuse action target?

topics.topic: Whether proven read-only flow versions auto-activate or require an explicit activate action
questions: Does a proven read-only flow version become active automatically at composition/proof time, or only when an explicit activate action is called?

topics.topic: Whether re-granting after revoke creates a new StandingGrant or reactivates the old one
questions: After revocation, does granting the same flow-version node create a new `StandingGrant` entity (new `grant_id`) or reactivate the revoked one?

topics.topic: Which operation classes are eligible for StandingGrant creation
questions: Can standing grants be created for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes (which do not stop for owner approval), or only for approval-gated classes?
